messages:
ashley: Friday LAN at the big table in the lounge — 7pm. Quick Q: who can bring an ethernet switch and extra power banks for Decks? We lost the office switch last time 😂

mike: I have a 8-port netgear switch and a handful of Cat6s (1x3m, 2x5m). I can bring them.

olivia: I can bring the projector + HDMI and a couple of surge strips. Also have an extension reel. :projector:

samir: I have two PD power banks (45W) for Steam Decks, but they only last ~3 hours. Anyone got the 60W ones?

lee: @samir i might have a 65W Anker. Can test if it charges while playing. Also can we mark table spots so we don't hog power?

ashley: @mike amazing, @olivia you're a lifesaver. @lee yes please mark spots. I'll make a tiny seating map.

lan-bot: Reminder: RSVP by Thursday 5pm. Current headcount: 7. Please include device type (PC/Switch/Deck).

mike: RSVP: Mike - PC (modded controller), + cables/switch.

olivia: RSVP: Olivia - Projector + Switch power strip.

samir: RSVP: Samir - 2x Decks, 2x 45W banks.

lee: RSVP: Lee - Switch, 65W bank.

ashley: RSVP: Ashley - PC + HDMI capture (maybe for some co-op clips).

ashley: Quick packing checklist I stole from last time:
```
- switch + patch cables
- power strips (2)
- extension reel
- HDMI + capture
- spare controllers + chargers
- deck power banks
```

ashley: Also: if anyone has a tiny 4-port unmanaged switch we can use for the NES shelf (retro corner), shout out.

mike: I can bring an extra 4-port if needed.

olivia: FYI the projector needs a dongle for USB-C -> HDMI if someone wants to plug a Deck directly.

samir: can someone bring a small tape roll and a marker to label plugs? last time I unplugged the router by accident 🤦

lee: i'll bring tape + marker.

ashley: Perfect. See y'all Friday. Food/drinks welcome. :pizza: If anything changes, reply here.
